metadata.capture_policy: Capability probes use startCapture -> subscribe -> trigger/action -> bounded wait -> stopCapture -> cleanup proof. Capture start/stop, accepted calls, returned IDs, and empty arrays are recorded only as context and never as promotion proof.
metadata.sandbox_policy: Each live probe copies tests/_org/2022.1/SampleProject.wproj into a sandbox and launches WwiseConsole against the sandbox only; tests/_org is immutable source.
metadata.task: 3. Implement profiler capability probe and evidence schema

assertions: startCapture and stopCapture boundaries are recorded as capture context, not standalone promotion proof

getList contains the created transport before destroy, and transport.stateChanged or getState transition must expose a state payload/field within the bounded wait, otherwise an exact missing-payload blocker is recorded
transport destroy, subscription cancellation, source fixture immutability, and sandbox cleanup are recorded

blockers.reason: WwiseConsole/headless may not publish transport.stateChanged for the copied SampleProject event; without a topic payload or getState transition, this remains capability-blocked.

capture_sequence: copy tests/_org/2022.1/SampleProject.wproj source fixture into a sandbox
call ak.wwise.core.profiler.startCapture and record returned capture cursor
create a transport for an existing sandbox Event object
subscribe to ak.wwise.core.transport.stateChanged with options {transport}
execute play then stop actions
bounded-wait for stateChanged payload or bounded-poll getState transition
call ak.wwise.core.profiler.stopCapture and record returned capture cursor
cleanup: execute stop action if transport was created
delete sandbox unless keep-on-failure policy applies
prove source fixture mtime and bounded hash are unchanged

evidence_rows.missing_payload_blocker: transport 0 did not produce a stateChanged payload or getState transition within 5.0s; initial_state='stopped', last_state='stopped'
evidence_rows.timestamp_window_mapping: capture start cursor/time through stop cursor/time bounds the play/stop trigger window

trigger.predicate: stateChanged payload for created transport or getState transition among playing/stopped/paused
